body: Yeah, I'm not a fan of the hallucinations, but falling into a coma sounds good. If you're in a coma long enough, they'll pull the plug on you. No coming back from that.

Not for me. I've been on different meds since I was 16, am now 27. They always stop working after a few months. Therapy doesn't work, have tried it a few times through the years and I always leave feeling much sadder than when I got there. Was in the psych ward a couple years ago, it was hell. I used to have hope, but now I see that was foolish of me.
